note: Order agent (decision docs/decisions/2026-11-12-food-by-phone.md). Same server path as the ask agent (voice-agent/task-call/): our server places the Twilio call and connects it with register-call, passing the variables compiled from the approved order card (server/messaging/src/taskCalls/payload.ts). Created by server/messaging/scripts/setup-task-call-agent.mjs --agent order; the server's drift check compares the live agent with TASK_ORDER_AGENT_SPEC in server/messaging/src/taskCalls/agentSpec.ts, which voice_agent_spec.py keeps in step with this folder.

variables.doddy_opening_line: AI disclosure + the order question, spoken word for word (server-built)
variables.doddy_question: the order question (server-built from the order)
variables.doddy_principal: the user's first name in the genitive
variables.doddy_order: the approved order: dishes, delivery address or pickup, courier phone, payment on delivery, highest total, name (server-built)
variables.doddy_order_confirm_line: the one sentence that accepts exactly that order (server-built)
variables.doddy_facts: only the facts the user ticked, one per line
variables.doddy_attempt: attempt id for matching the post-call webhook; not used in the prompt
